C1264.title: HTTPS Man-in-the-Middle Attack Prevention: Principles of Certificate Forgery and SSL Stripping
C1264.summary: A Tencent Cloud developer community article explains the process of HTTPS man-in-the-middle attacks, where an attacker acts like a postman intercepting client-server communication, replacing public keys and digital certificates to eavesdrop on and tamper with encrypted traffic.
